name: grade-book
description: Turn a score sheet into totals, averages, rankings and report cards. Drop in a spreadsheet with one row per student and one column per subject: full marks are guessed per subject (100, 150…) or set by you, subjects can be weighted, and every student gets a total, weighted average, band (优秀 / 良好 / 及格 …) and overall and class rank. Per-subject statistics for each class — mean, highest, lowest, pass and excellent rates — and score distribution charts come with it. Fix scores or write a comment for each student, then export an Excel grade book, one A5 report card per student and a summary PDF. Runs locally; no school system login or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 把成绩表变成总分、平均分、排名和成绩单。放入一张每行一名学生、每列一个科目的表：每科满分自动判断（100、150 等）也可手动设置，可以设科目权重；每个学生算出总分、加权平均、等级（优秀／良好／及格……）、年级和班级排名。同时给出各班各科的平均分、最高分、最低分、及格率、优秀率和分数段分布图。可以改分、给每个学生写评语，然后导出 Excel 成绩册、每人一页 A5 成绩单和统计报告 PDF。在本地运行，不用登录教务系统，无需 API 密钥。
